data.name: Dipan
data.long_meaning: The name Dipan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dip' which means 'luminous' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Dipan is also a name of the sun god, Surya. Therefore, the name symbolizes light, brilliance, and wisdom.
